name: Tessa Alley
title: Contact Psychologist
description: Tessa is a passionate psychologist who embraces a holistic approach to her clients – health and wellbeing. Utilising a person-centred, trauma-informed approach, she values the therapeutic relationship and focuses on fostering a sense of trust and safety. She has worked across a range of settings such as youth and adult mental health, private practice and within not-for-profit organisations – including with clients from LGBTIQA+ and culturally diverse communities. She predominantly utilises Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Motivational interviewing and Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) approaches, integrating elements of Schema therapy and Solution-focused therapy.
specialties: Diverse genders, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Mathew Pierce
title: Medicare Clinical Psychologist Provider
description: Hi, I'm Mat (he/him), a Clinical Psychologist, Board-approved supervisor, and Advanced Accredited Schema Therapist. I became a psychologist because of a genuine curiosity about people and a desire to make a meaningful difference in their lives. One of the most rewarding parts of my work is getting to know clients beyond their difficulties and understanding who they are as a person. I work with adolescents, young adults, and adults experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, eating disorders, low self-esteem, relationship difficulties, perfectionism, and self-criticism. My approach is tailored to your individual needs and draws on Schema Therapy, Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT), and other evidence-based approaches.
specialties: Diverse genders, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Dissociative Identity Disorder, Schema Therapy, EMDR

name: Dr July Lies
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: July Lies started working in the field of mental health in 2008. Her area of focus in trauma-informed intervention to young people, adult, and families from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds. Having a great passion to understand human resilience in the midst of adversity, her research focused on understanding the risk and protective factors of people developing Post-traumatic Stress and has published a dozen peer reviewed journal articles. As a family-inclusive and diversity-friendly therapist, July also provides affirmative support for clients of all backgrounds, gender identities, and sexuality. She has a special interest in working with trans, gender diverse and non-binary people.
specialties: Diverse genders, Diverse sexualities, Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR, Schema Therapy
